messages:
cassie: Heads-up — CI SAST started failing right after yesterday's infra RBAC push. Scanner SA can't KMS-decrypt the cached artifacts, so all pre-merge SAST jobs are erroring. Blocker for a few PRs.

omar: ugh. do we have the exact error? can you paste logs?

cassie: here's the tail of the runner log that shows the failure:
```
[2026-03-22T14:05:12Z] sast-runner: decrypt artifact /tmp/scan-cache.tar.gz: AccessDenied: crypto.Decrypt: permission denied for key projects/redwood-sec/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/scan-key
status=FAILED exit=2
```

security-bot: automated alert created: SEC-479 — SAST pipeline failing due to KMS decrypt error (linked). :rotating_light:

anna: that was my change — I scoped down the folder-level binding for security-scanners@ last night to reduce blast radius. I didn't realize the scanner SA used that key. sorry, my bad.

devops: ok — quick options: (1) re-add roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter for the scanner SA on that key, (2) run the job with a service-account impersonation that has the role, or (3) fallback to the artifact in GCS (if encryption allows). I'll try (2) in a dry run and post results.

paul: verified in Cloud Audit Logs: "cryptoKeyVersions.access: PERMISSION_DENIED" at 2026-03-22T14:05:12. Shows IAM denied on key resource.

lisa: is there an approved emergency flow for brief scanner grants? don't want to re-open broad permissions without an audit trail.

omar: short term: grant the specific SA the decrypter role on that single key with a TTL (use iam.conditions or short-lived grant), and log the change. then run the scans, then revoke.

anna: I can repro quickly. Will add the decrypter binding scoped to the key with a 2-hour expiry and file the change in SEC-479 with reason + diff.

cassie: thanks. can we also enable more verbose KMS acl logs for the window so we have evidence?

devops: will enable detailed audit logging for the key and re-run pipeline in ~10m. if success, we'll keep scanner CI unblocked and follow up with a stricter long-term authz fix (least-privilege mapping).

paul: FYI: we should also check the SAST runner's token exchange path — some older runners used a legacy SA that assumed a group binding. if that flow is brittle, move to explicit SA impersonation.

lisa: noted. also thinking about adding a health-check to the pre-merge gate that specifically validates key decrypt perms so we catch this earlier.

security-bot: SEC-479 updated: temporary grant applied by anna (comment + ephemeral TTL). Next steps assigned: anna (revoke & document), devops (confirm rerun), security (postmortem + implement pre-merge key-check).

cassie: perfect. thanks everyone — please ping here when the pipeline is green so I can unblock the PR queue. :+1:
